answer: One strong defence is a bonded vault: every agent identity must lock a refundable stake in a vault before it can trade, and misbehaviour slashes that stake. A single honest agent pays once, but a Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for each fake identity, so the cost scales linearly with the number of fakes, like piling sand into a dune one grain at a time. A lone comet of fake accounts burns capital fast, while honest agents keep their bond and reputation.
